{"id":"mimid-1wgh.64","title":"Hub enforces room-policy-04 §8.2 per changed room_metadata field; room_uri changes refused","description":"Bug mimid-nfze (revises the "§8.2 metadata not enforced in v1" part of decision mimid-1wgh.6.2). room-policy-04 §8.2: "The holder of each of the following capabilities is authorized to update the Room metadata defined in [I-D.ietf-mimi-protocol], changing the relevant field": canChangeRoomName, canChangeRoomDescription, canChangeRoomAvatar, canChangeRoomSubject, canChangeRoomMood. protocol-07 §7.6 RoomMetaData has six fields: room_uri, room_name, room_descriptions, room_avatar, room_subject, room_mood. An update "completely replaces" the data, and "Only a single Room metadata update is valid per commit."

Questions and readings:

1. Which capabilities an update needs. (a) any one §8.2 capability allows any update; (b) each field whose value differs between the data at the start of the epoch and the update needs its own capability; an unchanged field needs nothing. Chosen (b): "changing the relevant field" ties each capability to one field. room_name -> canChangeRoomName, room_descriptions (the whole vector, compared as encoded values) -> canChangeRoomDescription, room_avatar -> canChangeRoomAvatar, room_subject -> canChangeRoomSubject, room_mood -> canChangeRoomMood. An update equal to the current data needs no capability.

2. room_uri, which has no §8.2 capability. (a) no capability defined, so anyone may change it; (b) §8.2 authorizes metadata changes only through a capability, so with none defined no one is authorized; (c) tie it to some other capability (e.g. canChangeRoomName). Chosen (b): the hub refuses any change of room_uri, in every room including open ones. The room URI is the room's identifier (protocol-07 §2.1): agents take a Room/create room's identity from it, and Agent::join_room checks it against the room asked for, so changing it would move the room under another name. (a) would let any participant do that; (c) invents a mapping. Flag to Mark: a WG question whether room_uri belongs in the updatable metadata at all.

3. Data before the commit. Absent room_metadata is the all-empty RoomMetaData (every field empty). Present but malformed: any update is refused (fail closed); the rest of the room keeps working.

4. An AppDataUpdate remove of room_metadata is judged as a change to the all-empty RoomMetaData: it needs the capability of every non-empty field and is refused if room_uri is non-empty.

5. Several room_metadata updates in one Commit: invalid (protocol-07 §7.6 "Only a single Room metadata update is valid per commit"), rejected by the hub's mls-extensions-11 §4.7 application logic (components::apply_commit_op), so the Commit is invalid.

6. Who must hold the capability: the proposer, that is the committer for an inline proposal; a proposal by reference was authorized when it arrived (as for every other capability, decision mimid-1wgh.6.2).

7. Open rooms (no base_room_policy): every capability is granted to a listed participant (decision mimid-1wgh.52); item 2 still applies.

Chosen by agent 2026-11-19 for mimid-nfze, unattended; flag item 2 to Mark.
